intro.text: The youngest daughter of Lunamor, from the Horneater Peaks.

items.text: Beautiful Song travelled for months with her family from the Horneater Peaks to join Lunamor, who had sent for them after he reached the Shattered Plains. On the way their caravan was attacked by Voidbringers; the family sheltered behind a pile of furniture, and one of them shot a singer with an Unkalaki arrow. A Bridge Four patrol found them and brought them to Urithiru.
She was only four when the family reunited with Lunamor, and didn't remember him after he had been away so long, which broke his heart.
Lunamor took Beautiful Song and most of the family, apart from Cord and Gift, back to the Horneater Peaks, not planning to return.
